description: "Our Hundred Days in Europe" by Oliver Wendell Holmes is a travel memoir detailing the author’s experiences during a trip to Europe, written in the late 19th century. The narrative primarily follows Holmes as he embarks on this journey accompanied by his daughter, reflecting on the vast changes in Europe since his last visit over fifty years earlier.
